features_used.day_of_week: Day of the week (0=Monday, 6=Sunday), capturing intra-week shopping patterns.
features_used.day_of_month: Calendar day of the month (1-31), capturing salary cycles and mid-month surges.
features_used.month: Calendar month (1-12), capturing seasonal and quarterly retail trends.
features_used.quarter: Financial quarter (1-4), tracking macro retail performance shifts.
features_used.is_weekend: Binary flag (1 for Saturday/Sunday, 0 otherwise) capturing footfall spikes.
features_used.is_month_end: Binary flag (1 for last 3 days of calendar month), tracking end-of-month clearance promotions.
features_used.lag_1: Sales volume on immediate previous day (T-1), capturing short-term auto-regressive momentum.
features_used.lag_7: Sales volume 7 days prior (T-7), capturing same-day-of-week seasonality.
features_used.lag_14: Sales volume 14 days prior (T-14), capturing bi-weekly retail cadence.
features_used.lag_30: Sales volume 30 days prior (T-30), capturing monthly baseline sales.
features_used.rolling_mean_7: 7-day trailing simple moving average shifted by 1 to prevent data leakage.
features_used.rolling_std_7: 7-day trailing volatility / standard deviation shifted by 1.
features_used.rolling_mean_30: 30-day trailing baseline moving average shifted by 1.
features_used.trend_step: Ordinal continuous time index capturing long-term growth or decline trend.
